headline: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute opens new branch in Erode
hook: New Erode facility opens for business
summary: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute Limited has officially commenced commercial operations at its newly established branch in Erode. This expansion increases the healthcare provider's geographical footprint within the region. Retail investors should note this operational milestone as a driver for potential patient volume growth. The announcement was submitted directly to the stock exchange as a routine corporate update.
why_it_matters: Branch expansion may drive higher patient revenue over time
winners_losers: Lotus Eye gains / competitors locally pressured
